briefs.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips designed to track every vaccinated person.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and medical institutions, including Mayo Clinic, FactCheck.org, and Indonesian government sources, state that claims of microchips in COVID-19 vaccines for tracking individuals are false. FactCheck.org, in December 2020, clarified that discussions about chips were for tracking vaccine doses, not people, and would be attached to vials. Tempo.co and Periksa Fakta also debunked similar claims in 2020 and 2021, including those linking Bill Gates to microchip implantation or magnetic properties in vaccines. Experts consistently affirm the impossibility of implanting tracking microchips due to size and technological limitations.
